ZWE.note: The report is payment statistics and names no e-procurement system.
The report gives statistics only and states no mandate, licensing, switch oversight or regional link.
No consumer-protection rule or complaints body is stated.
No government payment to people is stated.
Only subscriber and transaction counts are given, no survey share of adults.

facts.fact: The Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe reports mobile money carried 206,575,490 transactions, 86.70% of volume and 10.51% of value, in Q4 2025, with 10.96 million active mobile financial services subscribers.

ZWE.note: No tax or fee payment is stated.
